## Project Summary

TI Mindmap HUB automates the processing of OSINT threat intelligence reports
using Large Language Models. It produces structured outputs including STIX 2.1
bundles, IOC extraction, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, and weekly threat briefings.
The platform exposes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with 19 tools for
AI assistant integration (VS Code + GitHub Copilot, Claude Desktop).
